apps.name: Lens
apps.subtitle: Native iPhone camera
apps.localizedDescription: Native iPhone camera with PNG and RAW capture, Portrait and Low Light modes.
apps.versionDescription: - Front camera now gets the 60 fps viewfinder. The format report showed a 1024x768 4:3 format at 60 fps with full 12 MP stills; Lens had been skipping it because it only accepted formats at least 1440 px wide. The minimum is now 1024 px. The front preview is slightly lower resolution than the rear one; photos are still 12 MP.
